system.description:
Cast as a spell: duplicates any Cleric spell of 8th level or lower, using your caster level and spell DC and ignoring its material components; the duplicated spell's own save applies. Cast as a Ritual (no slot; 1 hour of prayer; 10,000 gp of offerings consumed; you gain 2 levels of Exhaustion): choose one: return a dead creature to life as True Resurrection, with no body or time limit needed; end any curse, disease, affliction, ability loss or Exhaustion; or transport up to 8 creatures anywhere on any plane.

Costly component: see Rare Spell Components in the Shopkeeper's Catalogue.

Classes: Cleric
